key: Integrator with Wrapped State (Discrete or Continuous)
title: Integrator with Wrapped State (Discrete or Continuous)
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time integrator with wrapped state, 1 input, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Wrapped state upper limit} sets the state upper limit, {Wrapped state lower limit} sets the state lower limit and {Initial condition} sets the state initial value. Values come from the instance.
